bug_semantics: parseAndValidateClientRedirect allowlists client OAuth redirect_uri by scheme+host only (path/query/fragment ignored). GetOAuthLoginURL/BindOAuth embed the client redirect into the signed state JWT with no pre-check. After callback the server redirects to that path with a one-time exchange code; a same-host attacker path (Referer, analytics, open redirect) can leak the code, which POST /api/auth/exchange trades for access/refresh tokens. CWE-601. CVE-2026-79662 remains PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn).
